relationship.statement: For small angles, a pendulum's period depends only on its length and gravity, not on its mass or release angle. Longer pendulums swing slower.
assumptions: The string is massless and does not stretch.
Air resistance and pivot friction are negligible.
Release angles are small enough that sin(θ) ≈ θ.

quantities.label: Length
quantities.meaning: Distance from the pivot point to the center of the bob.

quantities.label: Bob mass
quantities.meaning: Mass of the weight at the end of the pendulum.

quantities.label: Release angle
quantities.meaning: Starting angle from vertical before the pendulum is released.

quantities.label: Gravity
quantities.meaning: Gravitational acceleration pulling the bob downward (9.81 m/s^2 on Earth).

quantities.label: Period
quantities.meaning: Time taken to complete one full back-and-forth swing.

quantities.label: Frequency
quantities.meaning: Number of complete swings per second.

quantities.label: Max speed
quantities.meaning: Peak speed of the bob as it passes through the lowest point.

math.code: function compute(inputs, t) { const L = 1.0; const g = 9.81; const T = 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(L / g); const f = 1 / T; const omega = 2 * Math.PI / T; const theta0Rad = inputs.theta0 * Math.PI / 180; const theta = theta0Rad * Math.cos(omega * t); const theta_deg = inputs.theta0 * Math.cos(omega * t); const v_max = omega * L * theta0Rad; const bob_x = L * Math.sin(theta); const bob_y = -L * Math.cos(theta); const angularVel = -omega * theta0Rad * Math.sin(omega * t); const vx = L * angularVel * Math.cos(theta); const vy = L * angularVel * Math.sin(theta); const vel_x = bob_x + 0.35 * vx; const vel_y = bob_y + 0.35 * vy; const bob_size = 0.25 + 0.65 * (inputs.m - 0.5) / 4.5; return { T: T, f: f, v_max: v_max, theta_deg: theta_deg, bob_x: bob_x, bob_y: bob_y, vel_x: vel_x, vel_y: vel_y, bob_size: bob_size, is_heavy: inputs.m >= 3.0, is_wide: inputs.theta0 >= 22 }; }

always: Length and gravity set the period.
explanation.otherwise: Mass and angle leave period fixed.

lesson.title: What changes a pendulum swing?
lesson.description: Watch a 1-meter pendulum swing and track its angle over time. Adjust the bob mass and release angle to see which ones change the period and speed.
lesson.instructions: Use the sliders to change bob mass and release angle. Play or scrub time to watch the swing and angle graph.
lesson.goal: See that mass and small release angles do not change the period, though a wider angle increases max speed.
